subject: Sustained tokens acceptance & MAP: Ledgerly POC — performance plan and results
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sustained tokens acceptance & MAP: Ledgerly POC — performance plan

Jamie —

Thanks for the quick sync today. Per our call I’m attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (Ledgerly_MAP_v1.pdf) and the benchmark-specs.xlsx that outlines the test harness, input distribution, and acceptance criteria we’ll use for the POC. High-level ask from your side: confirm the production-like sample traffic window and the business acceptance thresholds (TTFT, sustained throughput, and unit cost guardrails).

Proposed test window: Apr 20–21 (48h run) with three discrete phases: warmup (6h), steady-state sustained run (24h), and spike/recovery checks (remainder). Key success metrics we’ll report back on:
- Sustained tokens/sec (measured as median over the 24h steady-state)
- Sustained QPS (concurrent queries per second at target latency)
- TTFT (time-to-first-token) measured 50/95/99th percentiles
- Concurrency and backpressure behavior at 50–200 concurrent sessions
- Unit economics: per-1k-token cost for the steady-state workload and projected monthly cost at expected production volume

Please review the attached MAP and highlight any must-have acceptance criteria (e.g., max 95th TTFT = 180ms, or unit cost < $0.15 per 1k tokens). If that looks good, we’ll lock the run and schedule the exact start time. I’ll loop in Rishi (performance eng) to run and own the harness and Neha to own commercial acceptance.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior GTM Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

Date: 2027-04-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained tokens acceptance & MAP: Ledgerly POC — performance plan

Sofia —

Thanks for the materials and the clear plan. A few quick items from our side:
- We can provide the production-like traffic window for Apr 20–21, target consumer workload (~1.2B tokens/day).
- On acceptance thresholds: we’re willing to target a 95th TTFT <= 200ms for the POC, and sustained tokens/sec that project to ~10–12k tokens/sec at our expected query mix.
- For unit economics, procurement expects a modeled cost per 1M tokens and a monthly estimate for 20M queries. Can you confirm what cost assumptions you’ll surface (GPU amortized / infra / licensing)?

Also, can you confirm whether the harness will replay exact user prompts or a sampled distribution? We prefer sampled distribution that includes long-tail prompts.

Jamie Ortiz
Head of Platform Engineering, Ledgerly
jamie@ledgerly.com

P.S. Please include Rishi and your perf team in the thread for the exact test harness and metrics reporting.

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained tokens acceptance & MAP: Ledgerly POC — performance plan

Looping in Rishi and Marissa — Rishi will run the harness and produce the per-phase metrics; Marissa will align on timeline and closure criteria with Procurement.

Rishi / Marissa —
Planned test characteristics from Ledgerly: sampled production distribution (including long-tail prompts), expected 10–12k sustained tokens/sec target range, and 95th TTFT target of 200ms. Ledgerly also asked us to show projected unit economics for a 30-day run at different commitment levels (baseline, committed, reserved GPU). See benchmark-specs.xlsx for the recording and replay approach; we’ll run three sequential runs in the window: baseline config, quantized model variant, and cached/prefix-optimized run.

Request: please confirm the harness config (concurrency levels, instance types) and the exact output file format (CSV with per-minute aggregates is fine). Rishi, can you also include an initial hypothesis doc with expected token/sec and cost delta between variants?

Sofia

Onwards —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@ledgerly.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained tokens acceptance & MAP: Ledgerly POC — preliminary run 1 results

Jamie / Team —

We executed the first steady-state run (baseline config) earlier today; attaching the raw per-minute CSV (ledgerly_poc_run1.csv) and a short summary below. The harness used a sampled distribution with 12% long-tail prompts to emulate production behavior and the run targeted 11k tokens/sec target during the steady 24h window. Instance config: 4x A800 equivalent, continuous batching enabled, KV prefix cache warmup at start.

Summary (baseline run — 24h steady-state):
- Measured median tokens/sec (steady-state): 10,850 tokens/sec
- Measured sustained QPS (median over 24h): 42.6 QPS (mean query size ~255 tokens)
- TTFT: median = 78ms, 95th = 192ms, 99th = 286ms
- Concurrency profile: stable up to 120 concurrent sessions; queue depths increased after 170 sessions with graceful degradation
- Unit economics (baseline config):
  - Infra cost (amortized + infra): $0.098 per 1k tokens
  - Projected monthly cost at 10M daily tokens: ~$29,400 (baseline)
  - With quantized model variant (R&D run planned) we expect ~25–35% cost reduction on tokens/sec cost basis

Notes & recommendations:
- The 95th TTFT at 192ms is within Ledgerly’s 200ms target for this run; 99th is elevated due to occasional GC/eviction events during long-tail prompts — quantized path + prefix caching should reduce 99th significantly.
- For acceptance, we propose the following consolidated criteria to add to the MAP: sustained tokens/sec >= 10k (median), 95th TTFT <= 200ms, graceful degradation with <5% error rate at 150 concurrent sessions, and projected unit cost <= $0.13 per 1k tokens on committed capacity.

I’ve uploaded the CSVs and a short metrics table to the Drive link in the thread. Next step: run the quantized variant (Apr 21 morning) and then the cached/prefix-optimized run (Apr 21 evening).

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: ledgerly_poc_run1.csv (per-minute metrics), ledg_run1_summary.txt

From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@ledgerly.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-21T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained tokens acceptance & MAP: Ledgerly POC — preliminary run 1 results

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful and encouraging. Two quick clarifications: 
1) 99th TTFT at 286ms is higher than we’d like in production. Can you split the 99th into prompt-length buckets (<=128, 129–512, >512) to show the distribution and whether long-tail prompts are driving the tail?
2) For the unit economics projection, can you provide the committed-capacity model delta (per-1k-token) assuming a 6-month reserved commit? Procurement wants committed vs on-demand delta spelled out.

If the quantized run shows a 25–35% cost reduction as you estimate and improves tail latency, we’re on track to mark the MAP item for performance acceptance. Please rerun the quantized variant and include the bucketed tail numbers in the next note.

Jamie

Date: 2027-04-22T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained tokens acceptance & MAP: Ledgerly POC — quantized + final metrics

Jamie / Sofia —

We ran the quantized model variant and then the cached/prefix-optimized run. Consolidated results and final MAP acceptance entry below, plus attached final metrics table (ledgerly_final_metrics_table.csv).

Consolidated final metrics (steady-state, 24h):
- Median tokens/sec: 11,920 tokens/sec (quantized + caching)
- Sustained QPS: 46.8 QPS (mean query size 255 tokens)
- TTFT (quantized + caching): median = 72ms, 95th = 168ms, 99th (<=128 tokens) = 210ms; 99th (>512 tokens) = 462ms
- Concurrency tolerance: stable up to 150 concurrent sessions; graceful degradation up to 200 with backpressure and automated fallback to smaller model variants
- Unit economics:
  - On-demand baseline: $0.098 per 1k tokens
  - Quantized / committed 6-month reserved: $0.062 per 1k tokens (estimated with reserved capacity discount + improved throughput)
  - Projected monthly cost at Ledgerly expected volume (30M tokens/day):
    - On-demand baseline: ~$90,720/month
    - Committed reserved (6mo): ~$57,120/month

MAP acceptance item (proposed final wording to insert into MAP):
"Performance acceptance: Sustained median tokens/sec >= 10,000; 95th TTFT <= 200ms; 99th TTFT for <=128-token queries <= 220ms; graceful degradation with <5% error rate at 150 concurrent sessions; projected unit economics <= $0.08 per 1k tokens on committed reserved capacity."

Next steps/close timeline:
- Ledgerly review & signoff on acceptance language: by 2027-04-25 EOD
- Procurement to confirm reserved-commit pricing and SOW: by 2027-04-30
- Production rollout planning (pilot environment): target week of 2027-05-10

We’ve uploaded the final CSVs and a side-by-side metric comparison to the Drive folder. If Ledgerly confirms acceptance language by Apr 25, we’ll mark the MAP performance item as complete and move to commercial close items.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
